verdict.rationale: Trello has a public REST API, so this axis applies. However, the pack contains no documentation of an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. The only hint is the `1/authorize` route path, which is too thin to count as documented API versioning and says nothing about deprecation timelines or notice periods.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
